marketing.title: ReviewLens
marketing.subtitle: From Review Insights to Product Action, End-to-End
marketing.description: Supports Amazon, Shopee, TikTok Shop and more. Upload via Excel, CSV, or API. AI automatically analyzes reviews, highlights Top issues and wins, pushes to Feishu for team follow-up, and validates improvements with data.
marketing.ctaSecondary: Already have an account? Log in
marketing.value1Desc: Supports Amazon, Shopee, TikTok Shop and more. Upload via Excel, CSV, or API. AI extracts the Top 10 issues and highlights automatically.
marketing.value2Desc: Product issues are auto-pushed to Feishu, matched to the right team owner, with proposed actions and tracked follow-through.
marketing.value3Desc: After actions land, automatically track similar review trends and compare before/after data to validate real impact.

auth.ruleUppercase: Contains at least one uppercase letter
auth.passwordTooWeak: Password does not meet strength requirements
auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to access your review analytics workspace
auth.registerSubtitle: Sign up to start analyzing reviews instantly
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your registered email and we'll send a reset link
auth.resetSent: Reset link sent. Please check your inbox.

ad_copy.hint: Monthly ad copy generations; one platform × one type × one variant = one call.

webhook_count.hint: Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom webhooks configured (email is separate).

global_rules.label: Global Alert Rules
global_rules.hint: Max global alert rules across all products.

upload_rows_per_file.label: Per-file Upload Limit
upload_rows_per_file.hint: Max review rows per upload; split larger files.

upload.title: Upload Review File
upload.description: Select a file and fill in product info. The system will auto-queue analysis.
upload.importDesc: Upload a file or enter a product code to auto-fetch reviews.
upload.categoryPlaceholder: e.g. Bed Frame / iPhone Charger / Baby Bibs
upload.versionNotesPlaceholder: Optional, e.g. Updated packaging and materials...
upload.fileHint: Supports CSV, XLSX, DOCX, TXT. A task is created automatically upon selection.
upload.validationError: Please select a file and fill in Product ID, Version, and Purpose.
upload.statusPolling: Task is being analyzed in the background. Status updates automatically.
upload.statusDone: Task complete. Redirecting to results page.
upload.statusFailed: Task failed. Please check the uploaded file or backend logs.
upload.statusCreated: Task created. Waiting for backend processing.
upload.statusEmpty: After submitting a file, task status, progress, and summary will appear here.
upload.whatHappens1: 1. Parse file to extract review content, dates, and ratings.
upload.whatHappens2: 2. Create a background job — queued first, then analyzed row by row.
upload.whatHappens3: 3. After analysis, auto-redirect to results page for evidence and conclusions.
upload.categoryHitSuffix: category. Analysis will use category-specific aspect dimensions.
upload.categoryHitFallbackSuffix: sub-categories. Generic template will be used for analysis. Consider using a specific sub-category.
upload.duplicateWarning: This batch of reviews has already been analyzed.

workspace.title: Today's Workspace
workspace.description: Risk SKUs, team actions, pending reviews, and recent uploads — one operational view
workspace.todayTasksEmpty: Not enough data to generate tasks yet. Upload reviews or create action items first.
workspace.riskProductsEmpty: No high-risk SKUs detected. Good time for routine monitoring.

analysis.title: Analysis Results
analysis.description: Results page now navigable by session_id for direct access to real analysis content.
analysis.noSessionIdDesc: The results page is connected to the real API. Add a session_id to the URL to view results.
analysis.noSessionIdHint: Please provide a valid session_id — enter from the upload redirect or history page.
analysis.notFound: No matching analysis record found. It may have been deleted or the session_id is invalid.
analysis.loadException: An error occurred while loading results. Please try again or contact support.
analysis.moduleConsumerProfileDesc: Distills key audience segments, focus areas, and representative evidence from the review batch.
analysis.moduleUserExperienceDesc: Separates positive and negative feedback for quick assessment of experience stability.
analysis.modulePurchaseMotivesDesc: Summarizes why users buy and which selling points drive conversions.
analysis.moduleUnmetNeedsDesc: Highlights unmet needs for future product iterations and operational actions.
analysis.rawReviewsDesc: Original review text is preserved for tracing conclusions back to evidence.
analysis.noReviews: No raw reviews available for this batch.
